name: Sentrix
subtitle: Eight branches. One connected storefront and staff console.
description: A multi-branch storefront and staff back office for a security and surveillance retailer. Branch-scoped inventory and pricing follow each order from catalogue to checkout, with staff access enforced by role and record.
detail: Sentrix connects customer shopping and staff operations across eight branches. Inventory and prices belong to each branch, checkout reserves stock in a single transaction, and server-side permissions keep each role within its responsibilities.
features: Branch-level stock and pricing stay consistent from product browsing through order placement.
Checkout locks stock and writes the order in one transaction, preventing partial inventory updates.
Seven staff roles use 17 server-checked permissions, with sensitive records scoped to the branch where required.
The back office brings order queues, paid-revenue reporting, low-stock review, vouchers, and redemption history together.

name: Forkcast
subtitle: Turn a meal photo into an editable food log.
description: A mobile-first nutrition tracker that scans a meal photo, estimates foods and portions, and adds editable calories and macros to the daily log. The camera flow falls back to photo upload, and the AI scan can move across three providers when one fails.
detail: Forkcast pairs a camera-first food scan with a practical daily nutrition log. Scanned foods remain editable before saving, the app can fall back to image upload when camera access is unavailable, and the vision adapter tries Anthropic, OpenAI, then Gemini when a provider fails.
features: Food recognition cascades across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini, and identifies the provider that completed the scan.
Detected foods and portions can be corrected before they enter the log; scanned meals retain their photo.
The camera requests the rear-facing device and offers a file-picker path when browser permissions or hardware block it.
Nutrition targets are personalized during onboarding, while saved log entries keep their original nutrition snapshot.
The insights view brings calorie and macro trends, weight history, and logging streaks into one place.

name: Arawan
subtitle: A clear view of loans and daily collections.
description: A mobile-first loan tracker for managing borrowers, payment schedules, and daily collections. Its overview surfaces what is due and collected, while the ledger preserves corrections as reversals and reconciles opening balances.
detail: Arawan is a single-owner loan and collection tracker built around a reliable payment ledger. Borrower and loan records feed the daily overview, opening balances can be reconciled, and payment corrections are recorded as reversals instead of silently changing history.
features: The overview shows principal, interest, expected collections, overdue accounts, and recent payment activity.
Payment corrections are preserved as reversals in the ledger, with opening balances reconciled against each loan.
Supabase Auth and row-level security restrict borrower and loan data to the single owner.
The mobile-first interface is installable as a branded progressive web app.

name: Tindahan
subtitle: Everyday storekeeping, ready for a phone.
description: A mobile-first point-of-sale PWA for a small sari-sari store. Record sales in a few taps, track profit and stock, complete weekly inventory counts, and move inventory data through Excel.
detail: Tindahan turns daily store tasks into a focused mobile workflow: record a sale, keep stock and profit current, review what needs restocking, and reconcile the shelf during a physical count. Its installable PWA keeps those tools close at hand.
features: A quick sale flow updates revenue, cost, profit, and inventory together.
Low-stock prompts and weekly physical counts help reconcile the shelf with recorded quantities.
Excel import and export support the store's existing inventory workbook.
Admin and member roles separate account management and audit history from everyday store work.

name: My Notes
subtitle: A private notes board with live search.
description: A personal notes board built on Laravel and Livewire. UUID-based records and server-side policies keep each note private, while live search and a deliberate delete flow make everyday editing feel quick.
detail: My Notes moves beyond basic CRUD with per-note authorization on every read and write. Livewire keeps the board responsive without a separate SPA, and deterministic card colours, debounced search, and a confirm-before-delete interaction make the notes easy to scan and manage.
features: UUID note identifiers and server-side policies protect private notes even when an ID is known.
Search filters note titles and bodies as you type, with a short debounce to keep requests measured.
Each note keeps a stable pastel colour, and delete asks for confirmation before removing it.
Livewire navigation moves between the board, editor, and profile without a full-page reload.
